department_value_ids.description: For the Approver role only: the department values to narrow it to (FR-ADM-01, rev 0.253). Appendix D's department-qualified cells then reach only the records, lines and budgets of these values; an Approver role given with none reaches none of them. Another role is refused.

expires_at.description: For an external user: when it ends. Never on the Owner role.

sod_override_reason.description: In a team mode that blocks conflicts (Standard): why the member keeps the conflict of §6.3 this role makes. The role change's approver accepts the override, which is reported with the team mode (TEAM-02, rev 0.42).
examples: Founder who also keeps the books until we hire
